domain_definition: Joint matching of data-type family and nullability (same structural Domain definition used elsewhere in SchemaBridge). Legacy Exp5 domain_facts scoring is historical and is not the paper Domain metric.
rt_aggregation: For each eligible gold element, average the match indicator over available describers; micro-average those element-level means; Retention = RT/Direct at full precision before rounding to three decimals.
population_note: Split Entity/Referential Gold N use Direct evaluation-row micro counts (including rare duplicate Direct rows). Recovery Gold N uses unique eligible elements in the paired Direct/RT population (Entity 2087 vs 2161; Referential 4197 vs 4214). Tables/Attributes/Domain Gold N match across tables.
